content: WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3: AA normal text 4.5:1, large text 3:1. SC 1.4.6 AAA: 7:1 normal, 4.5:1 large. SC 1.4.11 non-text (UI components): 3:1 minimum. CRITICAL EXCEPTION: disabled/inactive UI components are EXEMPT from contrast requirements. Must measure contrast against the COMPOSITE/blended color (text color vs effective color after overlay applied to background), not against the overlay color alone. Semi-transparent overlays on dark backgrounds reduce effective contrast unpredictably.
